name: io.github.mestika/sendpro-flowmailer-mcp
title: Spotler SendPro / FlowMailer
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Spotler SendPro API, formerly FlowMailer.

environmentVariables.name: SENDPRO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client id for the SendPro API.

environmentVariables.name: SENDPRO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret for the SendPro API.

environmentVariables.name: SENDPRO_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow only SendPro read requests. Defaults to true.
